name: Drop an object into a container
description: Hold the object 5 cm above a container's opening, centred, and let go; the object falls in.

precheck.name: holding
precheck.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: base_near
precheck.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: uncovered
precheck.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

verifier.name: inside
verifier.meaning: Object centre inside the container's wall profile, between its floor and 3 cm above the rim.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.name: hand_empty
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

relations.when: more items go into the same container
a gentle release inside is needed

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
